question: What practice has been compassionately revealed by the god to the goddess?
premises: The god is addressed as the revealer.
The teaching was given out of compassion.
The subject revealed is the practice of the supreme nature.
inference: Out of compassion, the god has revealed the practice of the supreme nature.
uncertainties: parā-prakṛti may refer to supreme nature or to the supreme goddess.
plain_english: O god, out of compassion you have told the practice of the supreme nature.
